# AUTHORED from published sources, NOT captured from Claude Code or a pod.
# The first turn of a Claude Code 2.1.293 session that names a model id Claude Code does not
# recognise (the gateway alias `code`), over `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`.
# Derived from https://code.claude.com/docs/en/llm-gateway-protocol (read 2026-10-15):
#   "Inference requests post to `/v1/messages?beta=true`"; the "Request headers" table
#   (`anthropic-version` "currently `2023-06-01`", `anthropic-beta`, `x-claude-code-session-id`);
#   the "Feature pass-through" table (adaptive reasoning sends `thinking: {"type": "adaptive"}` to
#   model names it does not recognise; `output_config` carries effort; `cache_control` on
#   `system` blocks and `messages` entries); "System prompt attribution block" (a block first in
#   `system`, whose exact text is not published).
# The `anthropic-beta` values are illustrative: the page does not publish Claude Code's set.
# Effort `max` is one of Claude Code's five levels (low|medium|high|xhigh|max); vLLM v0.27.1
# admits it (vllm/entrypoints/anthropic/protocol.py:114) and the served Qwen3.8 chat template
# does not, so the gateway relays it as `xhigh`.
POST /v1/messages?beta=true HTTP/1.1
content-type: application/json
anthropic-version: 2023-06-01
anthropic-beta: context-management-2025-06-27,structured-outputs-2025-11-13
x-claude-code-session-id: 6f1c2a9e-3b7d-4e58-9a21-0c4d8e7f5b13

{
  "model": "code",
  "max_tokens": 32000,
  "stream": true,
  "thinking": {"type": "adaptive"},
  "output_config": {"effort": "max"},
  "system": [
    {"type": "text", "text": "[attribution block: client version and conversation fingerprint]"},
    {"type": "text", "text": "You are Claude Code, an interactive command line tool.", "cache_control": {"type": "ephemeral"}}
  ],
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": [
        {"type": "text", "text": "What does /tmp/a.txt say?", "cache_control": {"type": "ephemeral"}}
      ]
    }
  ],
  "tools": [
    {
      "name": "Read",
      "description": "Reads a file from the local filesystem.",
      "input_schema": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {"file_path": {"type": "string", "description": "The absolute path to the file to read"}},
        "required": ["file_path"]
      }
    }
  ]
}
